summary: Exact tool names whose completed tool-use inputs and results must be protected from automatic context clearing. Protected tool history remains in the request context, which preserves information but increases later input-token use.
combines: Applies only inside a `clear_tool_uses_20250919` context-management edit; it has no effect without that edit type.
Names must match the request's declared tool names exactly. Unlisted tool uses remain eligible for clearing when the configured trigger and keep rules are reached.
Use with the edit trigger, keep count, and clear-at-least threshold. Excluding many high-volume tools can prevent context management from reclaiming enough tokens.
